question: Please generate a summary of the closing balances at the end of each month for each customer transactions, show the monthly changes and monthly cumulative bank account balances. Ensure that even if a customer has no account activity in a given month, the balance for that month is still included in the output.
sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS DATE) AS month_date
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_date
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS DATE) AS month_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthly_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS DATE)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month_date,
        COALESCE(mc.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_changes mc 
        ON cm.customer_id = mc.customer_id AND cm.month_date = mc.month_date
),
with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_date,
        monthly_change,
        SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_date) AS cumulative_balance
    FROM combined
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_date,
    monthly_change,
    cumulative_balance
FROM with_balance
ORDER BY customer_id, month_date

args.sql:
WITH months AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS DATE) AS month_date
    FROM customer_transactions
),
customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM customer_transactions
),
customer_months AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, m.month_date
    FROM customers c
    CROSS JOIN months m
),
monthly_changes AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS DATE) AS month_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'purchase' THEN -txn_amount 
                    WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount 
                    ELSE 0 END), 0) AS monthly_change
    FROM customer_transactions
    GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 7) || '-01' AS DATE)
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        cm.customer_id,
        cm.month_date,
        COALESCE(mc.monthly_change, 0) AS monthly_change
    FROM customer_months cm
    LEFT JOIN monthly_changes mc 
        ON cm.customer_id = mc.customer_id AND cm.month_date = mc.month_date
),
with_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        month_date,
        monthly_change,
        SUM(monthly_change) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY month_date) AS cumulative_balance
    FROM combined
)
SELECT 
    customer_id,
    month_date,
    monthly_change,
    cumulative_balance
FROM with_balance
ORDER BY customer_id, month_date
